record.bible_text: Woe<WH01945> to thee that spoilest<WH07703><WTH8802>, and thou <FI>wast<Fi> not spoiled<WH07703><WTH8803>; and dealest treacherously<WH0898><WTH8802>, and they dealt not treacherously<WH0898><WTH8804> with thee! when thou shalt cease<WH08552><WTH8687> to spoil<WH07703><WTH8802>, thou shalt be spoiled<WH07703><WTH8714>; <FI>and<Fi> when thou shalt make an end<WH05239><WTH8687> to deal treacherously<WH0898><WTH8800>, they shall deal treacherously<WH0898><WTH8799> with thee.

O LORD<WH03068>, be gracious<WH02603><WTH8798> unto us; we have waited<WH06960><WTH8765> for thee: be thou their arm<WH02220> every morning<WH01242>, our salvation<WH03444> also in the time<WH06256> of trouble<WH06869>.
At the noise<WH06963> of the tumult<WH01995> the people<WH05971> fled<WH05074><WTH8804>; at the lifting up<WH07427> of thyself the nations<WH01471> were scattered<WH05310><WTH8804>.

And your spoil<WH07998> shall be gathered<WH0622><WTH8795> <FI>like<Fi> the gathering<WH0625> of the caterpiller<WH02625>: as the running to and fro<WH04944> of locusts<WH01357> shall he run<WH08264><WTH8802> upon them.
The LORD<WH03068> is exalted<WH07682><WTH8737>; for he dwelleth<WH07931><WTH8802> on high<WH04791>: he hath filled<WH04390><WTH8765> Zion<WH06726> with judgment<WH04941> and righteousness<WH06666>.

And wisdom<WH02451> and knowledge<WH01847> shall be the stability<WH0530> of thy times<WH06256>, <FI>and<Fi> strength<WH02633> of salvation<WH03444>: the fear<WH03374> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi>  his treasure<WH0214>. <RF>salvation: Heb. salvations<Rf>

Behold, their valiant ones<WH0691> shall cry<WH06817><WTH8804> without<WH02351>: the ambassadors<WH04397> of peace<WH07965> shall weep<WH01058><WTH8799> bitterly<WH04751>. <RF>valiant...: or, messengers<Rf>

The highways<WH04546> lie waste<WH08074><WTH8738>, the wayfaring man<WH05674><WTH8802><WH0734> ceaseth<WH07673><WTH8804>: he hath broken<WH06565><WTH8689> the covenant<WH01285>, he hath despised<WH03988><WTH8804> the cities<WH05892>, he regardeth<WH02803><WTH8804> no man<WH0582>.

The earth<WH0776> mourneth<WH056><WTH8804> <FI>and<Fi> languisheth<WH0535><WTH8797>: Lebanon<WH03844> is ashamed<WH02659><WTH8689> <FI>and<Fi> hewn down<WH07060><WTH8804>: Sharon<WH08289> is like a wilderness<WH06160>; and Bashan<WH01316> and Carmel<WH03760> shake off<WH05287><WTH8802> <FI>their fruits<Fi> . <RF>hewn...: or, withered away<Rf>
Now will I rise<WH06965><WTH8799>, saith<WH0559><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068>; now will I be exalted<WH07426><WTH8735>; now will I lift up<WH05375><WTH8735> myself.
Ye shall conceive<WH02029><WTH8799> chaff<WH02842>, ye shall bring forth<WH03205><WTH8799> stubble<WH07179>: your breath<WH07307>, <FI>as<Fi> fire<WH0784>, shall devour<WH0398><WTH8799> you.
And the people<WH05971> shall be <FI>as<Fi> the burnings<WH04955> of lime<WH07875>: <FI>as<Fi> thorns<WH06975> cut up<WH03683><WTH8803> shall they be burned<WH03341><WTH8799> in the fire<WH0784>.<CM>
Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, ye <FI>that are<Fi> far off<WH07350>, what I have done<WH06213><WTH8804>; and, ye <FI>that are<Fi> near<WH07138>, acknowledge<WH03045><WTH8798> my might<WH01369>.

The sinners<WH02400> in Zion<WH06726> are afraid<WH06342><WTH8804>; fearfulness<WH07461> hath surprised<WH0270><WTH8804> the hypocrites<WH02611>. Who among us shall dwell<WH01481><WTH8799> with the devouring<WH0398><WTH8802> fire<WH0784>? who among us shall dwell<WH01481><WTH8799> with everlasting<WH05769> burnings<WH04168>?

He that walketh<WH01980><WTH8802> righteously<WH06666>, and speaketh<WH01696><WTH8802> uprightly<WH04339>; he that despiseth<WH03988><WTH8802> the gain<WH01215> of oppressions<WH04642>, that shaketh<WH05287><WTH8802> his hands<WH03709> from holding<WH08551><WTH8800> of bribes<WH07810>, that stoppeth<WH0331><WTH8801> his ears<WH0241> from hearing<WH08085><WTH8800> of blood<WH01818>, and shutteth<WH06105><WTH8802> his eyes<WH05869> from seeing<WH07200><WTH8800> evil<WH07451>; <RF>righteously: Heb. in righteousnesses<Rf> <RF>uprightly: Heb. uprightnesses<Rf> <RF>oppressions: or, deceits<Rf> <RF>blood: Heb. bloods<Rf>

He shall dwell<WH07931><WTH8799> on high<WH04791>: his place of defence<WH04869> <FI>shall be<Fi> the munitions<WH04679> of rocks<WH05553>: bread<WH03899> shall be given<WH05414><WTH8737> him; his waters<WH04325> <FI>shall be<Fi> sure<WH0539><WTH8737>. <RF>high: Heb. heights, or, high places<Rf>

Thine eyes<WH05869> shall see<WH02372><WTH8799> the king<WH04428> in his beauty<WH03308>: they shall behold<WH07200><WTH8799> the land<WH0776> that is very far off<WH04801>. <RF>that...: Heb. of far distances<Rf>

Thine heart<WH03820> shall meditate<WH01897><WTH8799> terror<WH0367>. Where <FI>is<Fi> the scribe<WH05608><WTH8802>? where <FI>is<Fi> the receiver<WH08254><WTH8802>? where <FI>is<Fi> he that counted<WH05608><WTH8802> the towers<WH04026>? <RF>receiver: Heb. weigher?<Rf>

Thou shalt not see<WH07200><WTH8799> a fierce<WH03267><WTH8737> people<WH05971>, a people<WH05971> of a deeper<WH06012> speech<WH08193> than thou canst perceive<WH08085><WTH8800>; of a stammering<WH03932><WTH8737> tongue<WH03956>, <FI>that thou canst<Fi>  not understand<WH0998>. <RF>stammering: or, ridiculous<Rf>

Look<WH02372><WTH8798> upon Zion<WH06726>, the city<WH07151> of our solemnities<WH04150>: thine eyes<WH05869> shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> Jerusalem<WH03389> a quiet<WH07600> habitation<WH05116>, a tabernacle<WH0168> <FI>that<Fi> shall not be taken down<WH06813><WTH8799>; not one of the stakes<WH03489> thereof shall ever<WH05331> be removed<WH05265><WTH8799>, neither shall any of the cords<WH02256> thereof be broken<WH05423><WTH8735>.

But there the glorious<WH0117> LORD<WH03068> <FI>will be<Fi> unto us a place<WH04725> of broad<WH07342><WH03027> rivers<WH05104> <FI>and<Fi> streams<WH02975>; wherein shall go<WH03212><WTH8799> no<WH01077> galley<WH0590> with oars<WH07885>, neither shall gallant<WH0117> ship<WH06716> pass<WH05674><WTH8799> thereby. <RF>of...: Heb. broad of spaces, or, hands<Rf>

For the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> our judge<WH08199><WTH8802>, the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> our lawgiver<WH02710><WTH8781>, the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> our king<WH04428>; he will save<WH03467><WTH8686> us. <RF>lawgiver: Heb. statutemaker<Rf>

Thy tacklings<WH02256> are loosed<WH05203><WTH8738>; they could not well<WH03653> strengthen<WH02388><WTH8762> their mast<WH08650>, they could not spread<WH06566><WTH8804> the sail<WH05251>: then is the prey<WH05706> of a great<WH04766> spoil<WH07998> divided<WH02505><WTH8795>; the lame<WH06455> take<WH0962><WTH8804> the prey<WH0957>. <RF>Thy...: or, They have forsaken thy tacklings<Rf>

And the inhabitant<WH07934> shall not say<WH0559><WTH8799>, I am sick<WH02470><WTH8804>: the people<WH05971> that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> therein <FI>shall be<Fi> forgiven<WH05375><WTH8803> <FI>their<Fi> iniquity<WH05771>.<CM>
